title: Traders’ Toolbox: AI Order Placement Is Here
summary: Artificial intelligence has become a popular tool for research, market monitoring, and idea generation. But what happens when AI moves beyond analysis and begins placing trades? Interactive Brokers' Autonomous Trading framework is designed to explore that possibility while maintaining strict controls over what an AI can do and how much capital it can access.

###### Disclosure: Autonomous AI Trading Risk


Please keep in mind that there are material risks to autonomous AI trading, described in Autonomous Trading Risk Disclosure, especially agents placing orders you did not intend or that are erroneous or out of line with your trading wishes. Although these risks can never be eliminated, IB's integration is designed to limit the types of products your AI provider can trade, slow the speed of the orders it submits and give you the ability to control how much of your account you let the AI trade. If you link an AI provider, including browser-based and similar agents, you are providing those AI agents with full control of your account, without any controls or limits. Eligible clients may authorize a third-party AI platform to connect to their IBKR account. AI can make errors and may submit unintended orders. You are responsible for all orders submitted by your account.
